summary:
A Full-Stack Developer with 2 years of hands-on experience designing and building enterprise microservices platforms from the ground up. I take full ownership — from decomposing systems into independent services to designing database schemas, shipping resilient integrations, and crafting polished UIs.

Driven by an instinct for problem-solving and a relentless appetite for growth, I turn complex challenges into reliable, scalable solutions. Whether it's architecting a custom impersonation system with tamper-evident audit trails, building circuit breaker patterns for resilient third-party integrations, or debugging critical production issues across distributed services — I thrive where impact meets complexity.

I believe great software is built with ownership, clarity, and craft. Every line of code I write is in service of that standard.

bullets.text: Architected and built a 4-service microservices platform (Integrations, Events, Profile, Frontend) powering an enterprise learning management system
Integrated 9+ third-party systems — LinkedIn (certificate image processing), Zoom SDK, Skillable Labs, D365, Azure Communication Services, and more
Developed the React 19 SPA with 13+ pages, 4 context providers (Auth, Impersonation, Consent, ValidatedContact), MSAL interceptors, and scope-based token management
Built comprehensive test suites — unit, integration, E2E (Cypress), security, negative, and performance tests with sub-200ms thresholds
Designed and implemented a custom impersonation system with dual-token JWT validation, 15-minute session expiry, and tamper-evident audit trails logged to Azure Monitor
Built a full RBAC authorization system with fine-grained permissions (resource_type + action), junction tables, and role permission audit history
Implemented Azure AD token-based database authentication with Sequelize, including proactive 45-minute token refresh cycles and connection pooling
Developed a user provisioning pipeline that auto-creates users in Microsoft Entra ID via Microsoft Graph API, with secure password generation and status tracking
Built circuit breaker patterns (Opossum) with exponential backoff and fallback strategies for resilient external service calls
Engineered service-to-service communication for real-time impersonation session validation across microservices
Implemented centralized error handling with standardized error definitions, input sanitization (SQL keyword stripping), and email regex validation across all services

projects.name: AI Chatbot
projects.description: Full-stack AI chatbot supporting 9 providers (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Grok) through a unified interface with bring-your-own-key architecture.
highlights: Integrated 9 AI providers via unified adapter pattern, enabling seamless model switching
Implemented privacy-first architecture with client-side key storage — zero server-side credential persistence
Built context-aware conversation memory for multi-turn interactions

projects.name: UI Buddy — Multi-Viewport Preview
projects.description: Responsive QA tool that renders any URL across multiple device-sized viewports with synchronized navigation, scroll, and form interactions.
highlights: Built cross-viewport synchronization for navigation, scroll, and form inputs using postMessage API
Engineered proxy layer to bypass iframe restrictions by stripping frame-blocking headers
Supports up to 6 simultaneous device viewports with preset configurations

projects.name: Missing Person Finder
projects.description: Facial recognition web app that matches uploaded photos against a registered database to help locate missing individuals.
highlights: Implemented AI-powered face matching using dlib and face_recognition library with high accuracy
Built registration and search workflow for missing person cases with confidence scoring
Deployed on Hugging Face Spaces for public accessibility

projects.name: idea — Smart Notes
projects.description: Note-taking app with intelligent TF-IDF search engine and cross-device sync — find notes instantly with natural language queries.
highlights: Built intelligent search engine using TF-IDF scoring with fuzzy matching for typo-tolerant queries
Implemented real-time cross-device sync with offline-first architecture and background sync
Containerized with Docker for consistent deployment across environments

projects.name: 3D Animated Portfolio
projects.description: Immersive personal portfolio featuring interactive 3D scenes, scroll-driven animations, and glassmorphism UI built with Next.js and Three.js.
highlights: Rendered real-time 3D scenes with React Three Fiber including particle effects and floating geometry
Implemented scroll-driven animations with GSAP and Framer Motion for immersive UX
Optimized with SSR, code splitting, and dynamic OpenGraph images for SEO

projects.name: Ball Bounce
projects.description: Browser-based arcade game with real-time physics, progressive difficulty, and cross-input support (mouse, keyboard, touch).
highlights: Built smooth 60fps game loop using requestAnimationFrame with real-time physics calculations
Implemented progressive difficulty system that scales gravity and speed with player score
Supported multi-input control (mouse, keyboard, touch) for cross-device compatibility
